entities.summary: Jesper Boqvist is a Swedish professional ice hockey player who is a centre for the Florida Panthers of the National Hockey League (NHL). Boqvist was selected 36th overall by the New Jersey Devils in the 2017 NHL entry draft. He won the Stanley Cup with the Panthers in 2025.
